expanded_prompts.sm-winged-008-normal-attempt001.txt:
Use case: stylized-concept. Asset: one original, gentle fantasy creature for a hand-drawn 2D creature-raising game.
Create exactly ONE new full-body creature, not based on any existing character.
Locked v2 anatomy and materials: Exactly one horizontal elongated oval seed-coat body with a shallow upward-facing depression, not a crescent or an open hole. Exactly two round eyes and exactly two broad gently rounded flat membrane wings, slightly translucent and clearly plane-like, not inflated bags. No legs, arms, ears or tail. Smooth seed-coat skin and soft membrane wings.
Locked pose and personality: Float gently with the shallow depression facing slightly upward and the two wings raised diagonally, facing image-right. Shy tranquil manner.
Palette roles primary / secondary / dark accent, respectively: #586CA1 / #CDBBE8 / #A9DDD3. Preserve the primary color on the main body, secondary on scales or tufts or soft wings, dark accent for contours and eyes.
Mandatory identifiers: horizontal oval seed body with shallow upper depression; two rounded planar membrane wings; floating with no legs or tail.
Style: clear variable-width dark colored outline, restrained three-step cel shading, soft upper-left lighting, modest tactile material cues, appealing proportions. No photorealism or glossy 3D rendering.
Composition: full body, light top-down three-quarter view. Output MUST be exactly 1024 by 1024 pixels RGBA PNG. Center the creature inside the central 80 percent of the square; its longest extent 800–850 pixels and at least 80 completely transparent pixels on each edge. Show all specified appendages distinctly, no cropping.
Background: genuine transparent alpha, no drawn checkerboard, no ground, no shadow, no glow. Depict only the creature; no habitat, rocks, leaves, props, clothing, scenery, text, letters, logos, watermarks, frames or extra anatomy.

Required targeted quality correction: Remove ALL unrequested decorative appendages and patterns: remove the small leaf-like flaps at both wing roots, joining each of the TWO membrane wings directly and simply to the body. Remove the mint vine-and-leaf graphics from the body, leaving plain smooth seed-coat skin. Preserve two large rounded planar membrane wings, two eyes, the shallow upward-facing body depression, no legs and no tail. Keep the existing silhouette, pose and palette.
Keep all other anatomy, proportions, palette placement, viewing angle, pose and expression the same.
Complete design constraints: Exactly one horizontal elongated oval seed-coat body with a shallow upward-facing depression, not a crescent or an open hole. Exactly two round eyes and exactly two broad gently rounded flat membrane wings, slightly translucent and clearly plane-like, not inflated bags. No legs, arms, ears or tail. Smooth seed-coat skin and soft membrane wings.
Palette: #586CA1 / #CDBBE8 / #A9DDD3.
Maintain a clean hand-drawn 2D fantasy game illustration with a dark outline and restrained three-step cel shading. Full body, one character, transparent background. Do not add any scene, objects, text or extra body features.
Output must be a 1024 by 1024 RGBA PNG. Center the subject with at least 80 pixels entirely transparent on every edge, its longest extent 800–850 pixels. No cropped parts, ground, shadow, glow, watermark or frames.
